proposed_widenings.name: mounted_companion
proposed_widenings.justification: Several figurines key mechanics off the user riding the spawned creature, and the current atom vocabulary has no mount/rider state to attach those effects to.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you ride the goat, any Hostile creature that starts its turn within a 30-foot Emanation originating from the goat must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw...

proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics.upkeepCost
proposed_widenings.justification: Goat of Traveling spends charges per hour or portion of an hour while active, which is not activation-time spending and is not representable by the current resource grammar.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge.

proposed_widenings.name: CreatureDismissal.returns_to_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The figurines revert to statuette form rather than simply disappearing, and the current dismissal surface only models disappearance.
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form.

proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellTargetRestriction.attached_companion_only
proposed_widenings.justification: Silver Raven grants a spell cast restricted to the currently spawned companion, which is narrower than self-only or visible-target restrictions.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast Animal Messenger on it.

notes: Did not author content files. The live surface already supports magic-item variant rosters and spawned companions, so this is no longer structural; the blockers are mount-state vocabulary plus several narrower surface gaps.
